answer_text: Use IKEv2 if your SonicWall NSa 3700 supports it. In the Cato Management Application, create the IPsec site and select IKEv2 as the IKE version. If the NSa 3700 is behind NAT or has a dynamic IP, consider using Cato’s Responder Only mode (the edge initiates and manages the IKEv2 session) and use an FQDN as the Cato identifier for best PoP placement. If the device cannot support IKEv2 parameters, use IKEv1 and the Cato-initiated connection type.
